sources.name: MiyooMini-Ports
sources.use: name, notes, image, porter, status, assets of the entries below, matched by repo; the other entries there are listed as not installable yet

ports.name: Hexen II
ports.get: Hexen II, GOG version. Copy everything inside its data1 folder into Roms/PORTS/Games/Hexen2/data1/. Music (optional): its music folder (Track02.ogg to Track17.ogg) into Roms/PORTS/Games/Hexen2/data1/music/. File name case doesn't matter.

ports.name: Tomb Raider
ports.get: Tomb Raider 1+2+3, GOG version (https://www.gog.com/en/game/tomb_raider_123). From its Tomb Raider 1 folder (GOG Galaxy: settings next to Play > Manage installation > Show folder) copy GAME.GOG and, for music (optional), 02.mp3 to 10.mp3 into Roms/PORTS/Games/OpenLara/Tomb Raider 1/. The first start unpacks GAME.GOG into DATA/ and FMV/ (about a minute, needs ~170 MB free) and deletes it.

ports.name: 3D Pinball Space Cadet
ports.get: 3D Pinball for Windows - Space Cadet, from your own Windows installation (Windows XP and earlier shipped it). Copy PINBALL.DAT, FONT.DAT, all SOUND*.WAV and, for music (optional), PINBALL.MID into Roms/PORTS/Games/Pinball/. The first start converts the music (a few minutes, once).

ports.name: Fallout
ports.get: Fallout, GOG or Steam version. Copy MASTER.DAT, CRITTER.DAT and the data folder into Roms/PORTS/Games/Fallout/. Don't copy fallout.cfg from the PC (delete it if it's there): the game writes its own.

ports.name: Fallout 2
ports.get: Fallout 2, GOG or Steam version. Copy master.dat, critter.dat and the data folder (if your installation has one) into Roms/PORTS/Games/Fallout 2/. Don't copy fallout2.cfg from the PC (delete it if it's there): the game writes its own. The Restoration Project mod works too: see the port's README.

ports.name: Mario Kart 64
ports.get: Your own Mario Kart 64 (USA) cartridge dump (.z64, .n64, .v64 or zipped). Where the port looks for it: see its README. The game data is built from it on the first start.

ports.name: Diddy Kong Racing

ports.name: Carmageddon
ports.get: Carmageddon Max Pack, GOG version: run miyoo\install\install_gog.bat from the port's repository on a Windows PC with the GOG offline installer, then copy build\sdcard\Roms to the card with a card reader (thousands of small files). Or the free demo: its DATA folder into Roms/PORTS/Games/Carmageddon/.

ports.name: Carmageddon Splat Pack
ports.get: Carmageddon Max Pack, GOG version (it has the Splat Pack): run miyoo\install\install_gog.bat from the port's repository on a Windows PC with the GOG offline installer, then copy build\sdcard\Roms to the card with a card reader.

ports.name: REDRIVER2 (Driver 2)
ports.get: Your own Driver 2 (USA) PlayStation discs, both, as CHD or BIN/CUE in Roms/PS (where Onion's PlayStation games go).
